name: Tsunapara
source:
All-age dating game at junior high school with three Anime Reborn characters available - Hayato Gokudera, Mukuro Rokudo and Kyouya Hibari.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一款以初中为舞台的全年龄恋爱游戏，可攻略《家庭教师HITMAN REBORN!》中的三名角色：狱寺隼人、六道骸和云雀恭弥。
